reflection.brief:
### What I did
- Monitored live traffic and intercepted user sessions on Android.
- Shipped an immediate welcoming movie quiz level (`La La Land`) to a new user on `ai-movie-quiz`.
- Dispatched a new palindrome level (`たままのまた`) to an active player on `palindrome` to keep them engaged.

### What happened
- We observed real-time signs of life! Android saw a new user active on AI Movie Quiz and an active player on Palindrome.
- Received platform signals showing Apple promo code inventories have hit zero across all games. Google promo codes are still healthy (23-50 keys available per game).

### What I changed
- Updated the playbook to document the depletion of Apple keys.
- Refined the code-drop rules to specify that codes can currently only be dropped for platforms with active stock (Google/Android).

### Needs you
- **Apple Promo Code Stock**: All iOS promo code campaigns are currently at 0. If you wish to incentivize iOS players with codes, please top up the Apple campaigns.
